# SPD-056 — Acceptance: CutoverReadinessTest counts only the home's notes, so BadTakes tickets rendered into ledger/ fail three tests

## Brief
Since BAD-001 and BAD-002 were rendered and committed into the home ledger (commits dccf137, f7a4783), the live-HEAD round trip imports 55 tickets while the test's corpus counts 53, and import events name ledger/tickets/BAD-00n.md and ledger/teams/BADS-00n/*.md that sources() leaves out. The suite is red on a clean branch from main, which blocks Spud's rerun-the-suite landing step for every ticket.

Evidence: On the SPD-043 worktree (HEAD 51f4eba plus hook-only changes): test_acceptance.CutoverReadinessTest test_import_counts_match_the_corpus (55 != 53), test_import_events_point_at_the_source_paths (extra BAD/BADS paths) and test_every_source_file_is_generated_and_nothing_else fail; the tests exercise init, import and render, none of the Bash hook code SPD-043 changed.
